verdict.rationale: Tilled documents multiple onboarding integration options—an API-driven merchant application flow, a no-code hosted option, and an embeddable OnboardingJS component—plus Plaid-based bank account verification, matching the story's core need for both hosted and embeddable seller onboarding. Missing for 10: explicit mention of KYC/KYB terminology and terms-of-service acceptance step within the application flow, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
